parsed.modern: Culture. This plant is very differently preferred in Britain; it delights to grow in crevices of rocks, old walls, &c. and always thrives left in an horizontal po- sure; so that, when planted either in pots or in the full ground, they seldom thrive, though they may be kept alive for some years.
